Not an engineer or a scientist? There’s still a place for you at Owkin.

We’re always glad to meet people who want to join us, whether or not a position is open today. We welcome spontaneous applications from profiles such as:

  • Business and partnerships: sales, business development, data and strategic partnerships, customer success

  • Product and project management: product managers, program and project managers, business operations

  • Marketing, communications and public affairs

  • Corporate functions: finance, legal, HR and talent, people operations, procurement and office management

You might be a good fit if you:

  • Believe AI can change how we discover and deliver treatments, and want to be part of it

  • Have a background in, or real curiosity about, pharma, biotech, healthcare or AI

  • Like working in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment where collaboration across teams is the norm

  • Are ready to learn quickly and bring your own ideas

What happens next:
If your profile aligns with a current or future need, we will contact you to arrange a conversation. Otherwise, with your consent, we will keep your details on file and reach out when a suitable opportunity arises.

What we offer

  • Flexible work organization

  • Friendly and informal working environment

  • Opportunity to work with an international team with high technical and scientific backgrounds

Recruitment Process & Security

  • Please complete the form and submit your CV.

  • Owkin is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, color, religion, national origin, protected veteran status or on the basis of disability.

  • Owkin is a great place to work. As a coveted workplace we are, unfortunately, vulnerable to recruitment phishing scams. We urge all job seekers and candidates to be wary of potential scams. Most of these have individuals posing as representatives of prominent companies, including Owkin, with the aim of obtaining personal, sensitive, or financial information from applicants. These scams prey upon an individual’s desire to obtain a job and can sometimes “feel” like a genuine recruitment process. Some red flags are identified below. Should you encounter a recruitment process that claims to be for Owkin but is not consistent with the below, please do not provide any personal or financial information:

  • Legitimate Owkin recruitment processes include communication with candidates through recognized professional networks, such as LinkedIn.

  • Communication is always through an official Owkin email address (from the @owkin.com domain), over the phone or through our applicant tracking system (Ashby).

  • The Owkin talent team do use platforms such as LinkedIn, however if you have any concern or doubt about this contact, please ask for them to send an email from @Owkin.com.

  • The Owkin talent team will not solicit personal data from candidates during the application phase including, but not limited to, date of birth, social security numbers, or bank account information;

  • Legitimate Owkin interviews may be conducted over the phone, in person, or via an approved enterprise videoconferencing service (Google Meets). They will not occur via Signal, Telegram or Messenger

  • Owkin offers of employment are based on merit and only extended once a candidate has interviewed with members of the talent and hiring team. Offers will be extended both verbally and in written format.

If you think that you have been a victim of fraud,

  • Check the identity of the talent team on LinkedIn

  • Check our senior team on our website https://owkin.com/team/

  • Check the existence of the position on our website: https://www.owkin.com/careers#current-opportunities

  • Notify Owkin's recruitment unit at this address contact the following authorities:

    • [UK] https://www.actionfraud.police.uk/reporting-fraud-and-cyber-crime

Diabolocom is looking for a Technical Project Manager to coordinate engineering delivery across our organization and work closely with the Head of Software Engineering on roadmap execution.

You will work across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to keep delivery on track, manage dependencies, identify risks early, and help turn delivery challenges into clear actions and decisions.

We are looking for someone with a software engineering background who has moved into technical leadership and genuinely enjoys the operational side of engineering.

The role

Our engineering organization includes around 90 engineers across 12 teams, working on a complex global product and multiple parallel initiatives.

This role combines ownership of our engineering delivery processes with hands-on execution. You will be responsible not only for running these processes, but also for continuously improving how we plan, coordinate and track delivery across the organization.

Process ownership

You will own and continuously improve:

  • engineering delivery planning processes
  • delivery tracking and reporting
  • cross-team coordination and dependency management.

You will build on our existing practices and ClickUp workflows, identifying what can work better and evolving the processes as the organization and product develop.

Delivery execution

Day to day, you will:

  • track delivery across teams and releases
  • coordinate dependencies and clarify ownership across teams
  • identify risks, blockers and delivery gaps early
  • challenge unclear timelines, priorities and commitments
  • coordinate next steps when delivery is at risk
  • provide clear visibility on delivery status and progress.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams to facilitate alignment.

The objective is simple: make software delivery predictable, transparent and effective.

What success looks like

First few weeks: You start taking ownership of delivery operations and become effective in coordinating ongoing delivery.

Within ~6-8 weeks: You understand the roadmap, teams, dependencies and delivery processes well enough to manage them confidently and start identifying opportunities for improvement.

Within 3 months: You operate autonomously across day-to-day engineering delivery coordination, bringing in the Head of Software Engineering when decisions or trade-offs require escalation.

Your work will directly influence our delivery efficiency and predictability: how much we can take on and how reliably we deliver what we commit to.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who started in software engineering and moved into technical leadership, for example, an Engineering Manager, Technical Lead, senior Team Lead, or Technical Program Manager.

Titles matter less than scope. You need enough technical depth to understand architecture and dependencies, ask the right questions, and navigate complex delivery problems across teams.

We expect

  • around 10 years of experience in software engineering environments
  • at least 3 years in engineering or technical leadership
  • previous hands-on experience as a software engineer
  • experience leading or coordinating multiple engineering teams
  • a track record of delivering complex software initiatives and improving execution
  • strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, distributed systems and cross-team dependencies
  • understanding of Product Management fundamentals
  • experience with Agile and structured project management frameworks such as PMBOK or similar
  • strong prioritization, decision-making and communication skills
  • professional fluency in English.

French and Russian are nice to have.

This role will suit you if…

You still enjoy technical complexity, but what really motivates you is making execution work.

You like finding out why something is stuck and fixing it.

You genuinely enjoy the operational side of engineering: creating structure, improving processes, coordinating teams and making sure things get delivered.

You don’t just want to follow an established process. You naturally look for ways to make it work better.

You are comfortable working across multiple teams, asking difficult questions when needed, and bringing structure to situations where priorities, dependencies or timelines are not immediately clear.

Why Diabolocom

Diabolocom is building one of Europe’s most advanced AI-native CCaaS platforms, powering business-critical customer interactions for 400+ enterprise and mid-market customers across 60+ countries.

We combine a mature global CCaaS platform with a rapidly growing AI Product Suite, backed by our internal AI Research Lab and proprietary AI innovation.

Our ambition goes beyond adding AI features to an existing product. We are building toward a platform capable of orchestrating AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels, with CCaaS as the execution layer.

For Engineering, this means working on the technical and operational challenges of an established enterprise product, from real-time communications and distributed systems to complex integrations, while contributing to its next generation.

With teams across Europe, the US, Brazil and the UAE, and an engineering organization of around 90 people, this role offers the opportunity to work on engineering delivery behind a global product used for critical customer operations.

Why this role

This is a hands-on role combining delivery execution with process ownership.

You will work with the Head of Software Engineering, Team Leads, Product, Infrastructure and Project teams, with a broad view of engineering delivery across the organization.

You will inherit established delivery practices, own them, and continuously improve how we plan, coordinate and track execution.

Recruitment process

  1. Introductory call with Talent Acquisition
  2. Interview with the Head of Software Engineering
  3. Interview with the CTO
  4. Interview with the Head of Product

Build the infrastructure behind the next generation of AI-powered customer communications

Diabolocom is building an AI-first communication platform where AI agents, human agents, business workflows and communication channels work together seamlessly.

As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Head of Infrastructure to own and scale the infrastructure foundation behind this platform.

This is a unique opportunity to lead an infrastructure organization combining carrier-grade voice systems, on-premise data centers, distributed systems and AI workloads, while building the operational maturity required to support 2x growth.

You will report directly to Sergei, our CTO, and lead the infrastructure organization — owning operational excellence, team development and execution of infrastructure initiatives, while actively contributing to technical strategy and architecture decisions.

Why this role is different

Most infrastructure leadership roles today focus on managing cloud platforms and abstracted services. Here, you will own the foundations of a real-time, AI-first communication platform — from hardware and networks to telecom systems, distributed services, and operational processes.

Our philosophy is simple: we build and operate our infrastructure ourselves. 100% of our production infrastructure is managed by our teams, giving us full technical ownership, deep system knowledge, and the ability to solve complex challenges without relying on external vendors. This allows us to move faster, make better architectural decisions, and build systems tailored to our needs.

You will work across:

  • Telecom infrastructure — we are a global voice carrier powering real-time communications across multiple markets. We manage carrier relationships, routing decisions, and voice traffic flows end-to-end, with the expertise and tooling built internally.
  • On-premise infrastructure — around 95% of our production infrastructure runs on our own hardware across several data centers around the Paris and Frankfurt areas, with servers, networking, and connectivity fully managed by our teams.
  • Cloud infrastructure — while the majority of our production runs on-premise, we strategically leverage cloud services for remote locations and specific workloads where they provide faster deployment and operational efficiency, particularly for smaller-scale deployments.
  • Stateful systems — PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis, and others powering high-volume workloads.
  • Distributed systems — the platform is deployed in a fully redundant way across multiple data centers, with the ability to sustain the loss of a data center without impacting workloads.
  • AI infrastructure — GPU workloads and compute infrastructure supporting our AI capabilities.
  • Storage system — Ceph provides our main object and volume storage layer, supporting all other services across the infrastructure.

This is infrastructure engineering where reliability, latency, scalability, and operational excellence directly impact the product.

You will not simply maintain existing systems. You will help shape the architecture, processes, and team structure required for the next stage of our growth — taking ownership of critical infrastructure decisions from the ground up.

Your mission

Your goal is to make infrastructure ready for the next stage of scaling up by building a strong operational foundation across all the infrastructure domains.

You will:

  • Own infrastructure reliability and operations across the whole stack: incident management, monitoring, alerting, post-mortems and prevention of recurring failures.
  • Improve operational visibility across infrastructure teams: identify bottlenecks, improve processes and drive continuous improvements.
  • Improve capacity planning processes, connecting business growth and infrastructure needs.
  • Lead the evolution of our network and telecom infrastructure: topology, connectivity, carrier relationships, routing, redundancy and voice platform performance and reliability.
  • Own our on-premise infrastructure operations: data centers, hardware, storage, connectivity and deployment practices.
  • Drive scalability and reliability of our stateful infrastructure: PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Redis and other critical systems.
  • Support the evolution of our AI infrastructure, including GPU workloads and compute clusters.
  • Drive infrastructure improvements with automation, observability and tooling.
  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure applications run reliably on our platforms.
  • Lead and grow the Infrastructure team across Networking, SRE, Stateful Systems, Voice, and Data Center squads.

Who we are looking for

We are not looking for someone who has mastered every infrastructure domain.

We are looking for a strong infrastructure engineer and leader who has built complex systems, understands operational excellence and wants broader ownership.

You might be:

  • a Head of Infrastructure looking for a more hands-on technical challenge;
  • an Infrastructure Manager who still enjoys engineering;
  • a Staff/Principal SRE who has been leading infrastructure beyond their formal title;
  • a network or systems engineer who grew into technical leadership.

Must Have

  • Deep expertise in at least 2–3 infrastructure domains, such as:
    • networking;
    • SRE/reliability;
    • database administration;
    • telecom/voice infrastructure;
    • hardware/on-premise infrastructure.
  • Proven experience building and improving infrastructure operations: establishing processes, improving reliability practices, driving incident management and creating effective ways of working across multiple infrastructure domains.
  • Experience leading technical teams where different groups own different areas of infrastructure (for example networking, SRE, databases, systems or platform engineering).
  • Strong hands-on mindset: you stay close to technology, understand technical details and lead through context and expertise.
  • Self-taught, hands-on background — you have grown technically by solving complex problems beyond your formal role.
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken. French or other languages are a plus.
  • Ability to work onsite in Paris.

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • Telecom or carrier infrastructure.
  • Voice platforms or real-time communication systems.
  • PostgreSQL, Kafka, RabbitMQ or Redis operational experience at scale.
  • Dark fiber, peering and advanced networking.
  • Kubernetes in production.
  • GPU infrastructure.
  • Incident command and post-mortem culture.

About You

You are motivated by complexity and ownership, not titles.

You solve problems before being asked.

You are comfortable with ambiguity — infrastructure is complex, and you know how to make pragmatic technical trade-offs.

You enjoy building teams and scaling impact through people, not only systems.

You stay curious about networking, hardware trends, observability and modern infrastructure practices.

Why join us

Own infrastructure decisions with real business impact.

Your work will directly influence reliability, customer experience and engineering velocity.

Work on infrastructure that cannot simply be outsourced.

From telecom networks and hardware to distributed systems and AI workloads, you will solve problems where architecture and engineering decisions matter.

Build something from an early stage of maturity.

You will help establish the operational discipline, processes and team structure needed for the next phase of growth.

Work directly with technical leadership.

You will report directly to Sergey, our CTO, who is deeply involved in infrastructure and technical decisions while giving infrastructure leaders the ownership to drive changes.

Recruitment Process

  1. Intro call with Talent Acquisition
    Up to 1h — alignment on experience, expectations and motivation.

  2. Two technical conversations with Sergey, CTO
    Focused on:

  • infrastructure strategy;
  • technical depth;
  • architecture decisions;
  • operational leadership approach.

  1. Meeting with the infrastructure team
    Onsite or online session focused on collaboration, problem-solving and engineering culture.

  2. Final conversation with CEO

Logistics

📍 Paris, France
🏢 Hybrid model: minimum 3 days/week onsite
💻 Equipment: choose your preferred setup (Mac/Linux + monitors)
🍽 Lunch vouchers
🚇 Navigo: 50% of the monthly pass reimbursed
🏠 Relocation support available

One More Thing

We are not necessarily looking for someone who has already done this exact role in this exact environment.

The strongest candidates are often engineers who grew into leadership by taking ownership, solving complex problems and going beyond their formal responsibilities.

If you have built and operated complex infrastructure, enjoy solving ambiguous technical challenges and want to shape a critical engineering domain — we would love to talk.

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

data.description:
Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux.

Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles.

Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe.

Nos valeurs

Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler.

1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

2. Chacun fait la différence

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

Le poste

Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team.

  • Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison.

  • Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX.

  • Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps.

  • Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques.

  • Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille.

  • Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres.

Ton profil

Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe.

Indispensable

  • Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web.

  • Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale.

  • Un français écrit impeccable.

  • La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général.

  • Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire.

  • Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique.

Un plus

  • Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent).

  • Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles.

  • CVE, articles, talks, outils open source.

Avantages

Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre.

Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités.

  • Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk.

  • Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail.

  • Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris.

  • Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant.

Le process

C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

This role is based in our San Francisco office and is also open to remote candidates in the US.

We're hiring an Enterprise Demand Generation Marketing Manager to build and run the programs that fill our pipeline. You'll own campaigns across paid media, webinars, account-based marketing, and social, from strategy through launch and optimization.

This is a builder role. You'll stand up programs that don't exist yet, ship them quickly, and scale what works. You'll partner closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps to turn target accounts into qualified pipeline.

  • Plan, launch and optimize paid campaigns across LinkedIn, Google, Meta and content syndication channels, owning budget pacing, testing and reporting on CAC, pipeline and ROI

  • Stand up new channels and programs, test quickly, cut what isn't working and scale what is

  • Align daily with Sales, SDRs, Product Marketing, Content, Design and RevOps on targets, messaging and handoffs

What you'll need

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience running paid campaigns on LinkedIn, Google or Meta, with a track record of hitting pipeline targets

  • Experience running account-based marketing in close partnership with Sales, including account selection, orchestration and measurement

  • A track record of using paid and organic social as a demand channel

  • Strong analytical skills, comfortable with attribution, funnel metrics and turning data into decisions

  • Working knowledge of marketing automation and CRM tools (for example, HubSpot or Marketo, and Salesforce)

  • Experience marketing to large, complex organizations with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather create programs, processes and playbooks from scratch than inherit a finished machine

  • A collaborative approach; you work across teams every day, share credit, take feedback well, and treat Sales as a partner

  • Comfort using AI tools as part of your daily workflow, for drafting copy, building audience lists and analyzing campaign results

Nice to have:

  • Experience marketing to creative, media or enterprise audiences

  • Experience on an early-stage or scaling marketing team

  • Familiarity with AI tools that speed up campaign production and analysis

If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't check every box.

Ready to be part of the Legal Tech revolution? 

Vision: 

As a leading software-as-a-service (SaaS) provider, DiliTrust is a global company dedicated to offering an integrated suite of legal and governance products. Our vision is to digitize legal departments worldwide. With an annual growth rate of over 40% since 2020, our ambition is to become the world's leading Legal Tech company, aiming for a valuation exceeding $1 billion by 2026. 

Our Impact: 

From generating General Meeting reports to leveraging AI-assisted contract lifecycle management, our teams in our 8 offices across France, the US, Mexico, MEA, Germany, Spain, Italy, and Canada are the driving force behind our global success. We proudly support 2,400 customers in 64 countries, with 80% of our clientele comprising listed companies in major markets such as Europe, North America, and the Middle East. 

Our Recognition: 

DiliTrust has been at the forefront of Legal Tech innovation, being the first Legal Tech with AI features since 2022. The company is renowned for providing a positive and entrepreneurial work environment. We are honored to have received the "Happy at Work" and "Tech at Work" labels every year since 2019. 

The Role:

Lini is DiliTrust's proprietary AI engine, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite.

We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for a strong Software / Product Engineer, with a focus our platform architecture, to help us bring it to the next level. 

As a Software Engineer work at the intersection of AI, product, and engineering. You will contribute to building, improving, and scaling the features that make Lini a reliable and powerful AI layer across the entire DiliTrust suite. 

We are looking for an engineer who writes clean, production-ready code and is comfortable taking ownership of features end-to-end, from technical design to deployment. We also care about how you think about AI: whether you bring genuine curiosity to the product, and whether you can translate a model capability into a great user experience. 

Missions

  • Write specifications as the durable asset of the project. Executable acceptance criteria, and — crucially — the non-functional requirements that specs almost never carry: data classification, endpoint × role authorization matrix, volumetry assumptions, latency and throughput budgets. These are the requirements whose later correction is superlinear, so they get decided before generation, not after.
  • Freeze the contracts before any fan-out. API schemas, types, module boundaries, invariants. Agents do not negotiate an interface in the hallway: each will make a plausible and incompatible assumption, discovered at integration.
  • Pilot coding agents with a tight brief and a bounded context — narrow tasks, defined input and output artifacts, explicit stop conditions and budgets, full traceability of what produced each change.
  • Keep producer and verifier separate. You do not sign off alone on generation you piloted, and you act as independent verifier on your peers' slices — with an adversarial brief ("find what breaks against this spec"), never "confirm this looks fine".
  • Build the asymmetric gates that make the slice safe at volume — expensive to satisfy, cheap to check: property tests, contract tests, query-count and allocation budgets, execution-plan checks, policy-as-code, backward-compatibility proofs. Written before the implementation exists, so the agent closes the feedback loop itself without consuming human attention.
  • Use code reading as a calibration instrument, not as a gate. Sample deliberately, by risk zone, to measure the real defect rate of the generator-plus-gates pair and to keep the team's mental model of its own system alive.
  • Keep work-in-progress low. Capped PR size, thin vertical slices, trunk-based with very short branches, feature flags over long-lived branches, CI as the agent's first task rather than its last. More features in flight does not mean faster delivery when the bottleneck is verification.
  • Design for blast radius. Reversibility, progressive delivery, structured logs, traces, metrics and instrumentation generated as a matter of course. On many paths, detecting in five minutes beats three days of review that prevents nothing.

Requirements

Being based in France with full working rights. Fluent in French and English.

Experience & Seniority:

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a significant portion spent building and operating B2B SaaS platforms in production
  • Proven ownership of features across their full lifecycle — design, delivery, iteration, maintenance — on long-lived, multi-year products
  • Strong background in complex, scalable web architectures, including real modularity: you have seen where coupling stops parallel work dead

AI-Native Practice:

  • Demonstrated, sustained use of coding agents in production work — not autocomplete, but delegated implementation with review and accountability
  • A concrete, articulated view of where generated code fails: correlated defects rather than idiosyncratic ones, uniform surface quality that destroys the usual "look here" review signals, plausibility with no author to interrogate
  • Comfort being accountable for code you did not author, and the discipline to refuse a change you cannot explain

Verification & Quality:

  • Real fluency in property-based testing, contract testing, and deriving tests from the specification rather than from the code
  • Test-data strategy, including maintaining a volumetrically representative dataset as part of the verification apparatus — not a nice-to-have
  • Instinct for the difference between a rigorous check and a scalable one: does the cost of checking grow with the volume produced?

Security & Performance (non-negotiable on this role):

  • Authorization modelling in multi-tenant systems, and why declarative, centrally enforced authorization beats reviewing each endpoint. Generated code reliably checks who you are and regularly forgets whether you are allowed
  • Awareness of the attack surface specific to an agent-assisted pipeline: prompt injection through ticket descriptions, code comments and dependency READMEs; supply-chain risk on hallucinated package names; least privilege for non-human identities; and the most frequent risk of all — production data or proprietary code leaking into the development loop
  • Performance as a measured number rather than a code-reading opinion: query budgets per HTTP request, N+1, unbounded result sets, missing indexes on new query paths, network calls in loops, execution-plan review. These are invisible at test-data scale and expensive in production

Product & Team Collaboration:

  • Excellent written communication — specification writing is now a core engineering skill on this role, not documentation overhead
  • Extensive experience working directly with product managers, designers and stakeholders in a product-oriented setup
  • Strong sense of ownership and sound judgment on risk: what to build, what not to build, what residual risk is acceptable and why

Education:

  • Master's degree in Engineering or equivalent practical experience in senior SaaS environments

What this role is not

We would rather say it up front:

  • It is not a prompt-engineering role, and it is not an ML/LLM research role.
  • It is not a role where green tests are sufficient evidence. On security and performance, "the spec is met and the tests pass" is not a weak signal — it is a null one.
  • It is not a ticket queue. The profile that shrinks in an AI-native team is the one whose value was implementing assigned tickets between two boundaries.

Our Tech Stack

  • Backend: Node.js / TypeScript
  • Frontend: Vue.js 3
  • Database: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
  • DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform
  • Cloud: GCP

Engineering apparatus you will use and help build: coding agents orchestrated deterministically in CI, aspect-scoped verification agents (authorization, performance, spec conformance, dependencies), policy-as-code, property-based and contract testing, volumetric test datasets, load and endurance gates on critical paths, feature flags, progressive delivery and end-to-end tracing.

What we offer

  • Join a fast-growing company in a friendly, international environment — engineering primarily in Paris, with further engineering presence in Berlin, Montreal and Wilmington (DE), and offices across France, Italy, Spain, Germany, Canada, the USA, Mexico and Dubai;
  • Our "Remote Policy" guarantees that you can find the right balance between "Onsite" and "Remote";
  • Last but not least, all the day-to-day benefits of the CSE, luncheon vouchers, profit sharing bonuses, etc...

Recruitment process

  • Interview with a TA team member (30/45 mins)
  • Interview with the Engineering Manager (1h)
  • Technical interview (1h30) — two parts: turning an ambiguous requirement into a specification with executable acceptance criteria, then an adversarial review of an agent-generated diff against that specification
  • Interview with the CTO (45 mins)

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

 

Background and experience

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

 

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

International Brands ist ein schnell wachsendes Schweizer Unternehmen im Bereich Personal Care / FMCG. Mit unseren Marken bringen wir Produkte in zehntausende Verkaufspunkte weltweit, von Drogerien über führende Retail Chains bis hin zu E-Commerce.

Wir bauen Marken, die im Regal funktionieren.

Nicht nur auf Slides. Nicht nur auf Instagram.

Schnell. Sichtbar. Greifbar. Skalierbar.

Wir entwickeln und skalieren Marken, die Design, Produkt und Performance kompromisslos verbinden und genau dort gewinnen, wo es zählt: im Markt.

Über 90’000 Verkaufspunkte weltweit.

Und wir sind noch lange nicht am Limit.

Wir suchen einen Art Director (100%).

Keinen klassischen Designer.

Wir suchen den kreativen Kopf unseres gesamten Brand Powerhouses.

Jemanden mit einem klaren, tiefen Verständnis für FMCG Design. Jemanden, der weiss, was im Regal stoppt, Aufmerksamkeit gewinnt und Produkte verkauft.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt. Von Packaging über Markenwelten bis hin zu den kleinsten Details, die am Ende den Unterschied machen.

Jemanden, der Bestehendes hinterfragt, Dinge besser machen will und nicht akzeptiert, „wie es schon immer war“.

Die Rolle ist anspruchsvoll, schnell und sehr hands-on.

Wir suchen keinen Verwalter.

Wir suchen einen Macher.

Jemanden, der Verantwortung übernimmt, Tempo bringt und Dinge mit hoher Qualität konsequent umsetzt.

Jemanden, der Marken aktiv weiterentwickeln will. Nicht nur konzeptionell, sondern bis zum fertigen Produkt im Regal.

Du verantwortest alles, was unsere Marken visuell und kreativ nach vorne bringt – mit klarem Fokus auf FMCG Performance im Markt.

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung kreativer Konzepte über alle Brands hinweg mit Fokus auf Sichtbarkeit, Wiedererkennung und Wirkung

  • Projekte eigenständig steuern und umsetzen – von der Idee bis zum fertigen Produkt im Markt
  • Steuerung von Freelancern und externen Partnern mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Head of Brands sowie dem gesamten Team
  • Blick fürs Ganze: vom Produkt über Kommunikation bis hin zum physischen Umfeld

Du machst aus Design Produkte, die verkaufen. Und aus Kreativität Performance.

Qualifikation

  • 2–5+ Jahre Erfahrung im kreativen Bereich (Design, Art Direction o.Ä.)
  • Starkes Portfolio mit echten FMCG- oder Retail-Projekten und sichtbaren Resultaten
  • Sehr gute Skills in Figma sowie Erfahrung in UI und Web

  • Du nutzt AI als sinnvolles Tool im kreativen Alltag

Was nicht zu der Rolle passt

Du wirst hier nicht einfach gestalten.

Du wirst Marken bauen.

Produkte entwickeln, die sichtbar werden.

Produkte, die im Regal stoppen.

Produkte, die gewinnen.

Und Produkte, die Menschen kaufen.

Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Research Engineer (Agentic Reinforcement Learning) based in Switzerland.

As an AI Research Engineer specializing in Agentic Reinforcement Learning, you will drive research and innovation in next-generation intelligent systems.
You will develop advanced reinforcement learning techniques that improve decision-making, adaptive behavior, and performance across multimodal AI architectures.
Working with text, images, audio, and other data modalities, you will help build models capable of solving complex, real-world challenges.
Your work will involve designing scalable training infrastructure, optimizing reward mechanisms, and improving the reliability of autonomous AI agents.
You will explore cutting-edge approaches involving diffusion-based generative models, autoregressive architectures, and unified multimodal frameworks.
Through rigorous experimentation and benchmarking, you will push the boundaries of model performance, efficiency, and generalization.
This fully remote opportunity offers the chance to contribute to impactful AI research within a fast-moving, globally distributed technology environment.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will conduct advanced research and develop scalable reinforcement learning systems for multimodal AI applications. Your main responsibilities will include:

  • Research and develop reinforcement learning algorithms for multimodal models, including diffusion-based approaches for image generation, autoregressive models for multimodal understanding, and unified architectures integrating multiple modalities.

  • Design and implement scalable reinforcement learning infrastructure supporting distributed training across complex multimodal systems.

  • Develop and optimize reward modeling strategies to improve training stability, align model behavior with desired outcomes, and prevent reward hacking and related failure modes.

  • Create, curate, and maintain multimodal simulation environments and training datasets to support robust model development, evaluation, and benchmarking.

  • Design and implement rigorous evaluation protocols to measure model performance, monitor progress against established baselines, and validate research improvements.

  • Analyze and optimize policy performance across different modalities by identifying bottlenecks in training, credit assignment, reward optimization, and cross-modal alignment.

  • Investigate emerging reinforcement learning paradigms that enable AI agents to learn more effectively from environmental feedback.

  • Improve model exploration, decision-making, and adaptive behavior to achieve state-of-the-art performance in dynamic, real-world environments.

  • Conduct large-scale experiments and translate empirical findings into practical algorithmic improvements.

  • Publish and present research findings at leading international conferences, including ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate combines strong theoretical knowledge of reinforcement learning with hands-on experience developing and optimizing large-scale multimodal AI systems. The following qualifications and technical skills are expected:

    • Master's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline. A PhD in Machine Learning, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, or a closely related field is preferred.

    • Strong track record of AI research, including publications in leading international conferences.

    • Demonstrated experience conducting large-scale reinforcement learning experiments in multimodal and vision-centric systems, including online reinforcement learning environments.

    • Proven ability to improve domain-specific decision-making and achieve measurable gains in policy performance.

    • Deep understanding of reinforcement learning algorithms and optimization techniques applied to vision and multimodal learning.

    • Strong knowledge of policy stability, exploration strategies, sample efficiency, and optimization in complex, high-dimensional environments involving images, video, and other modalities.

    • Advanced proficiency in PyTorch and modern deep learning frameworks for computer vision and multimodal AI.

    • Hands-on experience building end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines covering simulation, model training, evaluation, and production deployment.

    • Ability to address fundamental reinforcement learning challenges, including sample inefficiency, exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and training instability.

    • Experience designing robust evaluation frameworks and using empirical research to continuously improve algorithmic performance.

    • Established research publication record at top-tier conferences such as ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, or ECCV.

    • Strong analytical thinking, scientific problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate advanced research into practical AI solutions.

      • Benefits

      • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely from anywhere in the world, with a globally distributed team.

Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

  • Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

  • Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

  • MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

  • Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

  • Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

  • Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

  • Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

  • Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

  • Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

  • Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

  • Knowledge of data center power architectures.

  • Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

  • Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

data.description:
You take a signed customer and turn them into a flagship reference, owning the journey from first go-live to a full rollout across their plants.

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We serve manufacturers from Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, and are backed by Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Palantir, McKinsey, Meta, Google, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT?

You will take a signed logo and turn them into a flagship reference. That means getting onto the shopfloor fast, understanding what drives their KPIs, and deploying Ethon's agentic workflows where the impact is highest. You implement the first use case while already mapping the next. Once one is live, you find the next one. When the engineer is sold, you bring in the plant manager. Once the plant manager is convinced, you get to the COO. This is what you'll do:

  • Own the deployment: You're the person who makes sure go-live happens on time and the customer's team knows how to use it. You handle the onboarding, the training, and the change management that gets a new platform embedded into daily operations.

  • Turn shopfloor problems into business cases: An operator tells you yield drops on line 3 every Tuesday night. You figure out why, quantify what it costs, and build the case for the next deployment. You're as comfortable talking to a process engineer as you are presenting to a VP of Operations.

  • Drive expansion: You know which teams in the account haven't seen Ethon yet, which problems are still unsolved, and what it takes to get the next use case signed.

  • Be on-site: You're in factories. The insights that matter don't come from email chains and slides, they come from being on the floor.

  • Feed the product: You're closest to what customers actually need. You bring that signal back to Engineering and Product and you help us build something better.

  • Work with the team: GTM & Sales brings the logo with your help as a trustworthy industry expert, you take it from there. You work tightly with Engineering on delivery and with the commercial team on expansion opportunities.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING?

The best people in this seat combine strategic thinking with the willingness to get their hands dirty on a shopfloor. We can teach you our product. We can't teach you to care about how things get made, or to push hard when a deployment is stuck.

  • You're technically sharp enough to understand a production process and commercially minded enough to turn a pain point into a business case

  • You have 3-5 years of experience in something demanding: consulting, enterprise tech deployment, or a career on the shopfloor

  • You know how to manage complex stakeholder environments, from shopfloor operators to C-suite sponsors

  • You've run change management or adoption programs and know what it takes to get people to actually use new tools

  • You have a builder mindset: when something isn't working, your instinct is to fix it rather than escalate it

  • You're open to travel 30-50% of the time

This is how we'll set you up in your first six months:

  • Months 1-2: Learn about product, customers, and how our best deployments get done. You shadow live accounts, learn the platform end-to-end, and expand your understanding of how manufacturers think. You start working on your first account.

  • Months 3-4: You own delivery for one or more accounts, with support from the team.

  • Months 5-6: Full ownership of one or more customers. You're running deployments, driving expansion conversations, and your first upsell is in motion.

Great fits tend to come from backgrounds like:

  • Deployment, implementation, or customer success at high-growth industrial tech companies (e.g., Palantir, c3ai, Rockwell, Siemens Digital Industries) where you owned outcomes

  • Top-tier consulting, ready to stop writing recommendations and start executing them

  • Digital transformation or operational excellence roles inside manufacturing companies, where things were moving too slowly for you

  • Manufacturing or process engineering, where you've lived the problems Ethon solves, you know what a plant manager actually cares about, and customers trust you the moment you walk onto their floor

  • A technical degree in chemical, mechanical, electrical engineering, physics, or a related field

Bonus:

  • Experience with MES, ERP, Historian, or quality systems in manufacturing environments

  • Fluency in German, French, or another European language

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU?

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct. People who prove themselves here outgrow their title fast.

Additionally, we offer:

  • Performance-based career & growth paths

  • On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

  • Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

  • Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

  • Flexible parental leave

  • Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar enables organizations to ship agentic code with confidence. Code creation is abundant, but confidence is scarce. Our core platform, SonarQube, verifies over 750 billion lines of code every day, delivering agentic verification and governance for all code. Trusted by more than 7 million developers and 75% of the Fortune 100, including teams at Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company, Sonar enables organizations to reduce outages, improve security, and lower the cost and risk of agentic software development.

Founded in Geneva and now headquartered in Austin, Texas, Sonar has a global team working across offices and hubs, including Silicon Valley, London, Bochum, Barcelona, Singapore, Tokyo, and the Washington, D.C. area. At Sonar, we’re enabling enterprises to build agentic software factories that can move quickly while maintaining the control, consistency and evidence required to ship with confidence. 


Position Description

As an Engineering Manager at Sonar, you will lead a squad of 8 developers to build, automate and operate software used by millions of Sonar customers worldwide. You will own the professional growth and development of your team, enabling them to build well-crafted software for our products, and promoting a high-performance engineering culture. 

You will improve our products by leading the elaboration of the squad's annual and quarterly objectives in close collaboration with the AI team while contributing to and overseeing technical architecture and engineering direction. 

You will help to bring consistency across Sonar’s engineering organization by collaborating closely with your engineering manager peers to foster and share engineering best practices.


What you will do

  • Lead and manage a team of Engineers, providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and contribute to the team's success.

  • Hold yourself and your team accountable to a high engineering standard.

  • Foster a safe culture of feedback, continuous improvement, and collaboration, encouraging team members to share their ideas and concerns openly.

  • Align feedback with other teams to ensure things operate smoothly between teams.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and team leads to develop and communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the company strategy and ensure that the team's work and focus align with this vision.

  • Ensure the squad defines clear objectives that are aligned with team, department, and company goals.

  • Be accountable for tracking sprint progress.

  • Be accountable that processes and ceremonies align with company expectations to deliver the best product successfully.

  • Ensure that the right level of collaboration happens with the squad stakeholders (Product Managers, developer squads, Marketing, Management, etc.).

  • Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals.

  • Be accountable that the onboarding of new team members is happening in the squad.

  • Lead by example, modeling the behaviors and values that the company holds dear, including humility and servant leadership.


    • Experience and qualifications

    The technical skills you will demonstrate

  • 8+ years of software development or equivalent experience in the software development domain, with a strong understanding of software testing. 

  • Having a developer mindset: experience with coding lifecycle, ability to produce secure code, to do code reviews, and to jump into an unknown codebase, language, and framework.

  • Advanced knowledge of the Java ecosystem

  • Good knowledge of at least one programming language along with its development environment to understand end-user's context and expectations.

  • Experience with Agile methodologies.

    •  

    The leadership skills you will demonstrate

  • 3+ years of experience in a leadership or management role, with a proven track record of delivering results and building high-performing teams.

  • A growth mindset and a passion for helping individuals and teams reach their full potential.

  • Strong decision-making skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and resources effectively.

  • Capability to make concrete progress in the face of ambiguity and imperfect knowledge.

    •  

    The soft skills you will demonstrate

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Ability to clearly identify the problem to be solved and articulate it, before jumping to possible solutions/actions.

  • Ability to deliver effective feedback.

  • Good listening skills.

  • Ability to face small conflicts in a healthy way and help parties resolve them.

  • High level of autonomy and still accepting help and feedback from team members and peers.

  • Ability to challenge yourself.

    • In-office culture

    We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having. 

    Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted  — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

     

    We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

    At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

    If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date. 

    Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior IT & Cybersecurity Auditor to join an international financial services environment and contribute to strengthening its technology, cybersecurity and risk management landscape.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise with a strong understanding of governance, risk and controls. You will take ownership of complex audit engagements, challenge existing practices and provide independent insights that support informed decision-making at senior management level.

This is an excellent opportunity for a technically experienced professional who enjoys investigating complex IT environments, identifying potential vulnerabilities and making a meaningful impact on the organisation’s security and resilience.

Responsibilities & Tasks

  • Plan, lead and deliver comprehensive IT audit engagements based on a risk-oriented approach, including the development of audit strategies and testing procedures.

  • Review and evaluate technology-related risk areas, including cybersecurity, IT governance, infrastructure, network security, access management, data protection, operational resilience and emerging technologies.

  • Apply your technical background to analyse complex IT architectures, identify potential weaknesses and assess the effectiveness of existing security measures and internal controls.

  • Review findings from penetration tests, vulnerability scans, security assessments and monitoring activities, translating technical observations into relevant risk insights.

  • Assess emerging technologies, particularly Artificial Intelligence and AI-driven solutions, and evaluate their implications for cybersecurity, governance and technology risk.

  • Present audit findings, recommendations and risk assessments to relevant stakeholders, including senior management and executive-level decision-makers.

  • Prepare structured and impactful audit documentation, ensuring that identified issues are clearly communicated and actionable.

  • Track remediation activities and evaluate the effectiveness of implemented measures.

  • Work closely with colleagues across IT, Cybersecurity, Risk Management, Governance and Business functions to promote continuous improvement and strengthen the overall control environment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems or a comparable discipline, alternatively equivalent professional experience.

  • At least 10 years of relevant professional experience in IT, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Technology Risk or a related technical field.

  • Experience working with technical security assessments, penetration testing results, vulnerability scanning solutions or comparable security tools.

  • Previous exposure to IT Audit, Internal Audit, External Audit, Technology Risk or another assurance-related function is highly desirable.

  • Professional certifications such as CISA, CISM, CISSP or equivalent qualifications are considered an advantage.

  • Interest in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning and AI-driven technologies, particularly in relation to security, governance and risk management. Practical experience in AI governance or AI-based solutions is beneficial.

  • Strong analytical capabilities, a structured approach to problem-solving and the ability to assess complex technical information independently.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge established practices constructively and engage with senior decision-makers.

  • Fluent English is required. German and/or French language skills are an additional advantage.

Benefits & Culture

  • Work in an international financial services environment where technology, security and risk management play a central role.

Das UZB ist eine dynamische Institution: 2016 gegründet und seit 2021 um rund 30 % gewachsen. Unsere Strukturen, Prozesse und Systeme lassen sich aktiv mitprägen. Sie verbinden eine finanzielle Schlüsselrolle mit der Möglichkeit, die Weiterentwicklung einer Unternehmung mit gesellschaftlichem Auftrag aus Geschäftsleitungsperspektive mitzugestalten. Da oltre 25 anni offriamo sui mercati globali cosmetici Made in Italy. Progettiamo, sviluppiamo, produciamo e confezioniamo in-house. La produzione è effettuata dalla nostra azienda italiana di Siziano (Pavia-Milano Sud). Sostenibilità, qualità, innovazione e sicurezza sono per noi valori chiave.

Per la sede di Lugano siamo alla ricerca di un/a IT Applications & AI Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione dell’ecosistema digitale aziendale, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni Microsoft 365, alle applicazioni interne, all’automazione dei processi e ai progetti di Intelligenza Artificiale. La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con le diverse funzioni aziendali, raccogliendone le esigenze e traducendole in soluzioni tecnologiche concrete. Avrà un ruolo sia operativo sia progettuale nello sviluppo, nell’integrazione e nel mantenimento delle applicazioni aziendali, contribuendo alla digitalizzazione dei processi e alla realizzazione di progetti innovativi per il business.

Principali responsabilità:

  • sviluppare, gestire e ottimizzare soluzioni e flussi basati sull’ecosistema Microsoft 365, con particolare riferimento a SharePoint, Power Automate, Power Apps, Teams e agli strumenti di collaborazione e automazione aziendale
  • supportare le diverse funzioni aziendali nell’analisi delle esigenze e dei processi, individuando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali, automazioni e applicazioni basate sull’Intelligenza Artificiale in grado di migliorare l’efficienza operativa, l’integrazione dei dati e l’esperienza degli utenti
  • partecipare allo sviluppo e all’evoluzione delle applicazioni gestionali aziendali, contribuendo all’integrazione di funzionalità AI, API, flussi di dati e soluzioni di automazione a supporto delle diverse aree di business
  • seguire, dal punto di vista tecnico e applicativo, lo sviluppo del progetto digitale dedicato al settore cosmetico, collaborando alla definizione delle funzionalità, alla realizzazione delle soluzioni, ai test e alla relativa integrazione nell’ecosistema aziendale
  • garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni sviluppate, gestendo attività di manutenzione, aggiornamento, test, troubleshooting, documentazione tecnica e supporto agli utenti, anche in collaborazione con partner e fornitori esterni


Requisiti richiesti:

  • conoscenza dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365 e capacità di sviluppare o configurare soluzioni basate su SharePoint, Power Automate e Power Apps
  • competenze di programmazione, preferibilmente in Python, e familiarità con API, database, integrazioni tra sistemi e tecnologie di sviluppo moderne
  • conoscenza dei principi e degli strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale, automazione e analisi dei dati, con interesse per la loro applicazione concreta nei processi aziendali
  • capacità di analizzare le esigenze del business e tradurle in requisiti funzionali e soluzioni tecniche sostenibili, scalabili e semplici da utilizzare
  • buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, autonomia operativa, capacità di problem solving e attitudine alla collaborazione con interlocutori tecnici e non tecnici


Requisiti formativi e professionali preferenziali:

  • laurea o diploma a indirizzo informatico, ingegneristico, scientifico o formazione equivalente
  • esperienza nello sviluppo, nella migrazione o nell’integrazione di applicazioni e flussi all’interno dell’ecosistema Microsoft 365
  • esperienza nella gestione del ciclo di vita di un’applicazione, dall’analisi dei requisiti allo sviluppo, test, rilascio, manutenzione e supporto agli utenti
  • familiarità con Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Git, SQL, servizi cloud, API REST e strumenti di versionamento del codice
  • esperienza, anche maturata attraverso progetti personali, formativi o professionali, nello sviluppo di soluzioni AI, chatbot, assistenti digitali, sistemi di automazione o applicazioni basate su modelli linguistici
  • approccio pragmatico e orientato alla soluzione, curiosità verso le nuove tecnologie e capacità di operare contemporaneamente su attività di sviluppo, integrazione e supporto applicativo
  • capacità di lavorare in team e di collaborare in modo trasversale con le diverse funzioni aziendali, comprendendone obiettivi, priorità e processi


Cerchiamo una persona curiosa, concreta e orientata all’innovazione, capace di coniugare competenze tecniche e comprensione delle esigenze del business.

Il profilo ideale possiede un approccio hands-on, autonomia operativa e interesse verso la sperimentazione di nuove tecnologie. È in grado di seguire un progetto dalla raccolta delle esigenze fino al rilascio della soluzione, mantenendo attenzione alla qualità, alla sicurezza, alla semplicità di utilizzo e alla sostenibilità nel tempo.

In GFL accogliamo con piacere ogni candidatura e crediamo nel valore delle persone, nella loro unicità e nelle loro storie. Valorizziamo la diversità e offriamo pari opportunità a chiunque voglia far parte del nostro percorso.
